To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the dynamics of the market for video game consoles are quality driven, and that the Xbox could have been driven out of the market had the strength of indirect networks and the consumer discount factors been higher.
the dynamics of competition in the video game console market are driven by the quality of platforms and the consumer discount rate of future applications.

(1) the market dynamics are driven by the quality of platforms when the strength of indirect networks and the discount factor are low; (2) the market dynamics can be driven by installed base when the strength of network and the discount factor increase; and (3) the market dynamics may be driven by the quality when the strength of networks and the discount rate are high, and the quality is large enough.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how platform quality affects the dynamics of competition in the presence of installed base, and how the dynamics in turn affect platform quality.
the dynamics of platform competition, and the role of installed-base, platform quality and customer expectations in driving the dynamics.
the role of installed bases in platform markets, and we find that the installed bases of platforms are important for the market dynamics, especially in markets with high consumer discount factors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the market dynamics in this market are quality driven.
the dynamics of platform competition are determined by the interplay between the installed base, the platform quality, and the consumer expectations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
installed base is not the key factor in driving the dynamics of the market.
installed base and platform quality are not the only determinants of platform success.
the market dynamics are driven by quality, but the market is fragile to changes in the strength of indirect networks effects or consumer discount factor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a small quality advantage can be decisive in the long run, even if a large installed base is present.

the market dynamics in a platform market are driven by the strength of the indirect network effect and the consumer discount factors of future applications, and that a platform with a quality advantage can be displaced by a lower quality platform if the strength of the network effect and the discount factors are sufficiently large.
the dynamics of competition between two platforms can differ significantly depending on the strength of network effects and consumer expectations.
